digest.component_or_area: Cloud ADF codec (Jira rich-text markdown conversion)
propositions: markdown_to_adf must encode Markdown syntax (headings, lists, code blocks, inline marks) into structured ADF nodes rather than literal text, with HTML comment preservation via self-verification fallback to plain encode
adf_to_markdown must decode ADF back to source Markdown with deterministic mark ordering to eliminate the strong+strikethrough 2-cycle oscillation
fit_markdown_to_adf_limit must measure the Markdown-aware ADF serialization length, not plain-text length, for accurate truncation
marklas and mistune are lazy-imported inside function bodies with ImportError routed to plain-text adf.py fallback to preserve stdlib-only engine contract and avoid vendoring blocking
AdfCodec remains an untouched pass-through; the three new functions are pure capabilities not wired to any live send path in this story
committed 360-body corpus fixture achieves 100% idempotence fixed-point and 15.6% structural richness, with zero conversion errors and no unscrubbed secrets
